---
title: "Support and maintenance funding"
description: "We’re delighted to announce we’ve received US$50k from the IOGP Sound and Marine Life JIP for continued PAMGuard support and maintenance."
date: 2026-06-14
---

The [PAMGuard team](../team/team.qmd) in St Andrews have received US$50,000 in a donation from the [IOGP Sound & Marine Life Programme](https://www.soundandmarinelife.org) for continued PAMGuard support and maintenance.

Hot on our list of tasks are: 


* Testing PAMGuard on Windows ARM PC's and building an ARM installer
* Further updates to PAMGuard tutorials
* Support to developers, especially those wanting to get their AI models to run within PAMGuard
* Continued support to users
* Develop an improved testing framework to provide greater stability in PAMGuard releases
